objective: Gate 5D post-audit R2 READ_ONLY: verificar estado fisico Communications usando sys metadata segura aunque la queue no exista. Confirmar config/log preservados, presencia/columnas/indexes de queue, permisos NOTIFICACIONES, links SUPERADMIN, communication connections y ausencia Toast. Sin secretos, DDL/DML ni Production.

queries.name: gate5d_post_r2_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() database_name,SUSER_SNAME() login_name,USER_NAME() database_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() original_login

queries.name: gate5d_post_r2_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name schema_name,o.name object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: gate5d_post_r2_queue_shape
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.tables WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue')) queue_present,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue')) queue_columns,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue') AND name IN ('IX_Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue_Pendientes','IX_Operativo_Notificaciones_Queue_Lock')) queue_indexes

queries.name: gate5d_post_r2_existing_rows
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig) config_rows,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Log) log_rows

queries.name: gate5d_post_r2_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT codigo,modulo,activo FROM dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos WHERE codigo IN ('NOTIFICACIONES_VER','NOTIFICACIONES_CONFIGURAR','NOTIFICACIONES_ENVIAR') ORDER BY codigo

queries.name: gate5d_post_r2_superadmin_links
queries.sql: SELECT p.codigo,COUNT_BIG(*) total FROM dbo.Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos rp JOIN dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Roles r ON r.rol_id=rp.rol_id JOIN dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos p ON p.permiso_id=rp.permiso_id WHERE r.codigo='SUPERADMIN' AND r.activo=1 AND rp.activo=1 AND p.codigo IN ('NOTIFICACIONES_VER','NOTIFICACIONES_CONFIGURAR','NOTIFICACIONES_ENVIAR') GROUP BY p.codigo ORDER BY p.codigo

queries.name: gate5d_post_r2_comm_connections
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) total FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones WHERE UPPER(ISNULL(system_type,'')) LIKE '%TWILIO%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(system_type,'')) LIKE '%WHATS%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(system_type,'')) LIKE '%SMTP%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(system_type,'')) LIKE '%EMAIL%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(nombre,'')) LIKE '%TWILIO%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(nombre,'')) LIKE '%WHATS%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(nombre,'')) LIKE '%SMTP%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(nombre,'')) LIKE '%EMAIL%'

queries.name: gate5d_post_r2_toast
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) toast_tables FROM sys.tables WHERE name LIKE 'Toast[_]%'
